analysis.executiveSummary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. (9-1, Win Championship) proposes sending a 2028 1st-round pick (Mile High Royal Lions' original pick, 79.3 D-AVI) to Rapid Valley Annihilation (2-8, Retool) for sophomore RB Ollie Gordon II (40.3 C-AVI / 73.1 D-AVI). While Gordon II provides immediate RB/FLEX depth during Week 11 byes (+2.65 PPR points over Michael Mayer at FLEX2), trading Corgi Loaf's last remaining 1st-round draft pick straight up for a Day 3 NFL running back is a steep overpay. AVI recommends revising the offer to request a 2027 or 2028 2nd-round pick back alongside Gordon II to balance trade equity while securing the necessary playoff push depth.

publicMarketAnalysis.summary: Ollie Gordon II was drafted in the 6th round of the 2025 NFL Draft by the Miami Dolphins. Due to backfield injuries in Miami during the 2026 season, Gordon II has seen heavy touch volume (16-25 touches per game recently). However, his Day 3 NFL draft capital and modest efficiency keep his public dynasty consensus around a mid/late 2nd-round pick, making a 1st-round pick return premium value.

verdict.rationale: While Ollie Gordon II provides useful RB depth and a Week 11 starter upgrade (+2.65 PPR points over Mayer at FLEX2 during Stevenson/JSN byes), trading Corgi Loaf's sole remaining 2028 1st-round pick (79.3 D-AVI) straight up for a 6th-round NFL draft pick RB (73.1 D-AVI / 40.3 C-AVI) is an overpay. Corgi Loaf should revise the offer to request a 2027 2nd-round pick back (such as 2027 2nd Corgi Loaf) to recapture draft equity while securing the RB depth needed for the title run.
